label: Full-system energy intensity
interpretation: Lower values make the clean-energy constraint less binding.

label: Annual clean-addition growth
interpretation: Growth rate for annual global clean-generation additions through 2046.

label: AETHER share of new clean generation
interpretation: Share of new clean generation that can be allocated to AETHER after other demand claims.

label: Clean-energy deliverability
interpretation: Discount for interconnection, firming, transmission, downtime, and siting mismatch.

label: Annual robot-output growth
interpretation: Growth rate for robot production relevant to AETHER construction and operations.

label: AETHER share of robot output
interpretation: Share of robot output available for AETHER rather than the rest of the economy.

label: Robots per MtCO2/year capacity
interpretation: Lower values mean each robot-mediated deployment system supports more removal capacity.

label: Terminal storage capacity
interpretation: Geologic, mineral, ocean, biomass, and product storage throughput available by 2046.

label: Delivered cost
interpretation: Full delivered cost after learning, energy, storage, MRV, finance, and operations.

label: Annual budget
interpretation: Public, private, and treaty-backed annual spending capacity.

label: 100-year durable credit fraction
interpretation: Fraction of gross captured CO2 credited after lifecycle and 100-year durability haircuts.

label: Residual emissions in 2046
interpretation: Positive emissions remaining when the AETHER system reaches industrial scale.

label: Rebound or delayed-abatement fraction
interpretation: Extra emissions or delayed abatement induced by cheap removal.

label: Gross overbuild factor
interpretation: Program design capacity above 100 Gt/y to cover durability and downtime.

label: Execution realization
interpretation: Coordination, permitting, supply-chain, and operations realization of designed capacity.
